best_match.fbbt_term: pupal antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 vPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding cluster was identified as a vPN cluster expressing a marker not expressed by DA1 lPNs, and intersectional labelling with a driver for this marker showed innervation of glomerulus DA1 (Xie et al., 2021). It is not known whether these cells are larval-born neurons (immature at pupal stages) or embryonic-born neurons (remodelling at pupal stages). Antennal lobe projection neuron of the pupa that will become an adult antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 vPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: DA1 vPNs (knot analysis). Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053702 pupal antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 vPN (exact match).
